verdict.rationale: Vanta documents continuous monitoring with automated tests that flag gaps and suggest fixes (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-34, vanta-docs-45). It also offers real-time webhooks for Vanta events (vanta-docs-4), which an admin could route into Slack, email, or ticketing with custom glue code. The MCP server can surface failing tests and generate remediation plans (vanta-docs-3, vanta-docs-6), which supplies some fix context. Missing for 10: native Slack, email, or ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow) alert integrations; documentation that webhook events cover test failures or configuration drift; evidence of what remediation context alerts carry; independent or hands-on corroboration.
